content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to CAPM Certification in Amarillo

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Verify you hold a secondary degree and have completed the required project management education hours. No prior work experience is necessary—CAPM welcomes career changers and early-stage professionals entering the field.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Contact Hours of Education
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot camp. Our intensive format covers the PMBOK® Guide essentials and exam domains, delivered by experienced practitioners who understand Amarillo's project environment.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Register with PMI and submit your official application, including proof of education completion. Pay the associated exam fee through PMI's portal to activate your eligibility window for the CAPM exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, practice questions, and study guides to build confidence. Schedule your CAPM exam through Pearson VUE and test at an authorized center or online.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your CAPM Credential
steps_items.text: After passing, earn professional development units (PDUs) over the standard three-year renewal cycle. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing training and resources to help you meet PMI's recertification requirements.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: Is the CAPM a good starting credential for {city} professionals?
fq_items.answer: Yes. The CAPM is one of the most recognized entry-level PM credentials and is highly regarded across industries in {city_state}. It demonstrates PM knowledge to employers even before you have years of experience.

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.

fq_items.question: Is this training delivered online?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Our CAPM training is fully live-virtual — no travel required. {city} students attend via video conference from wherever they are.
